CAPEC-88.name: OS Command Injection
CAPEC-88.description: An attacker manipulates the syntax of an OS command by injecting malicious input, causing the underlying operating system to execute unintended commands.

CAPEC-66.name: SQL Injection
CAPEC-66.description: An attacker injects SQL syntax into an application's input in order to alter query logic and access or modify data outside intended scope.

CAPEC-63.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
CAPEC-63.description: An attacker injects malicious script into web content that will be executed in the context of another user's browser session.

CAPEC-62.name: Cross Site Request Forgery
CAPEC-62.description: An attacker causes a victim's browser to send a forged, authenticated request to a target application without the victim's knowledge.

CAPEC-100.name: Overflow Buffers
CAPEC-100.description: An attacker sends more data than a buffer can handle, corrupting adjacent memory and potentially achieving code execution.

CAPEC-115.name: Authentication Bypass
CAPEC-115.description: An attacker circumvents authentication mechanisms to gain unauthorized access to a system or resource.

CAPEC-233.name: Privilege Escalation
CAPEC-233.description: An attacker exploits a weakness to gain elevated privileges beyond what was originally granted.

CAPEC-586.name: Object Injection
CAPEC-586.description: An attacker manipulates serialized data to inject malicious objects that execute when deserialized by the application.

CAPEC-221.name: Data Serialization External Entities Blowup / XXE
CAPEC-221.description: An attacker crafts malicious XML input containing external entity references to disclose local files or perform SSRF.

CAPEC-560.name: Use of Known Domain Credentials
CAPEC-560.description: An attacker leverages hard-coded, default, or previously compromised credentials to authenticate as a legitimate user.

CAPEC-125.name: Flooding
CAPEC-125.description: An attacker sends excessive requests or data to exhaust the target's resources, resulting in denial of service.

CAPEC-118.name: Information Gathering via Exposed Data
CAPEC-118.description: An attacker collects sensitive information that has been unintentionally exposed by the target system.
